body_markdown:
***Strengthens lending strategy across the Bank’s specialized business lines***


First Internet Bank announced that Nick Campbell has been promoted to Senior Vice President, Chief Lending Officer. In his new role, he will lead the Bank’s lending organizations, including Small Business Administration (SBA) Lending, Commercial Real Estate Financing, Acquisition, Development and Construction (ADC) Lending, Commercial & Industrial (C&I) Lending, Consumer Lending and Business Lending. He is responsible for leading lending strategy, driving portfolio growth and expanding the specialized lending solutions that help businesses and consumers achieve their financial goals nationwide.


“Nick has consistently demonstrated exceptional leadership, deep lending expertise and a strong commitment to serving our clients,” said Nicole Lorch, President and Chief Operating Officer. “His proven success across commercial real estate and business lending, combined with his strategic vision and collaborative leadership style, make him exceptionally well-suited to lead our lending teams and drive continued growth across the Bank.”


Reflecting on his new role, Mr. Campbell said, “I’m honored to take on this expanded leadership role and to work alongside the talented teams that serve our clients every day. First Internet Bank has built a strong reputation for helping businesses and consumers achieve more through specialized lending solutions and exceptional service. I look forward to building on that foundation, supporting our clients’ growth and helping drive the Bank’s continued success.”


Mr. Campbell joined First Internet Bank in March 2017 as Vice President, CRE Portfolio Manager. Since then, he has held positions of increasing responsibility, including Vice President, CRE Relationship Manager and First Vice President, Credit Administration, before being promoted to First Vice President, Commercial Real Estate in 2021 and later to First Vice President, Senior Credit Officer. During his tenure, he has helped drive the growth and performance of the Bank’s commercial real estate portfolio, particularly in construction and development lending. As Senior Credit Officer, he provided leadership for credit administration and risk management, partnered with lending teams on credit strategy and underwriting, and helped ensure the continued quality and performance of the Bank’s loan portfolio.


He brings more than two decades of lending and banking experience to his role. Prior to joining First Internet Bank, he held positions with FORUM Credit Union and Monroe Bank. He earned a bachelor’s degree from Indiana University and a Master of Business Administration from Ball State University.
